# Expense and Financial Reporting Database

Store transactions and produce reliable financial summaries.

Use a disposable PostgreSQL lab. See `datasets/README.md` for setup and safety notes.

## Required deliverables

ER diagram or schema notes, schema scripts, synthetic seed data, query library, validation checklist, and README.

-- Begin with a copy of datasets/postgresql-lab-setup.sql.
-- Design project-specific tables here; never run destructive resets in a production database.

tests.name: Data integrity
criteria: Schema constraints reject invalid values and missing relationships.
Test at least one duplicate/NULL/boundary condition where relevant.

tests.name: Query behavior
criteria: Query outputs match the acceptance criteria on included synthetic data.
Join grain, NULL behavior, ordering, and ties are documented where relevant.

tests.name: Safety and reproducibility
criteria: All data-changing tests use a disposable database or explicit rollback.
Setup, seed, reset, and verification steps are documented.
